scenarios.prompt: My tests pass locally but started failing in CI after yesterday's merge. Diagnose it before changing code.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate: unknown regression with an environment differential requires diagnosis before a permanent fix
acceptance_criteria: Do not propose an unexplained permanent fix

scenarios.prompt: This integration test fails about 1 in 20 runs. Help me find why instead of adding another sleep.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate: nondeterministic failure requires repeated evidence and timing/order/race investigation
acceptance_criteria: Reject arbitrary sleep as a causal fix

scenarios.prompt: Latency doubled after the deploy and CPU looks normal. I need to diagnose the regression.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate: measured performance regression has an unknown cause

scenarios.prompt: An API request succeeds at the gateway but the downstream worker sometimes never updates the database. Trace where it breaks.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate: multi-component failure requires boundary and correlation evidence
acceptance_criteria: Correlate one execution across relevant boundaries

scenarios.prompt: The service occasionally hangs with no exception. How do we diagnose whether tasks or locks are stuck?
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate: hang or deadlock diagnosis is in scope
acceptance_criteria: Do not treat a longer timeout as root-cause proof

scenarios.prompt: The build suddenly fails with an error we don't understand after upgrading the toolchain.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate: build failure with unknown cause requires evidence-driven diagnosis
acceptance_criteria: Preserve exact error and toolchain identity

scenarios.prompt: The vendor advisory says version 3.2.1 fixes the confirmed issue and we approved the upgrade. Apply the known patch.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate: only implementation of an already accepted fix remains
acceptance_criteria: Do not select systematic debugging as the primary skill
Do not restart causal investigation without contradictory evidence

scenarios.prompt: Add an export-to-CSV feature to this page.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate: feature implementation has no observed failure to diagnose

scenarios.prompt: Review this pull request for readability and architecture.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate: ordinary code review is outside the debugging responsibility

scenarios.prompt: Design a caching strategy for a new service that has no measured performance problem yet.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate: architecture and performance design without an observed failure is out of scope
clarify_or_activate_if_cause_unknown: diagnose first unless supplied evidence already establishes an accepted cause and correction
acceptance_criteria: Do not assume the cause is known
Activate when diagnosis is still needed
Do not activate when only an accepted implementation remains

scenarios.prompt: A regression test is failing for unknown reasons. Diagnose the cause, then add the smallest regression test and fix.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate: systematic debugging owns causal diagnosis; testing or TDD may own the later regression-test implementation
acceptance_criteria: Select systematic debugging for the diagnosis phase
Preserve the handoff boundary to testing/TDD after causal diagnosis
Do not collapse diagnosis into speculative test-driven patching
